name: Connected accounts
description: The caller's connected accounts — provider, granted scope, whether the grant can refresh itself, when it was obtained and when the current access token expires. Never the tokens.

refreshable.description: True when a refresh token is held, so the connection outlives the access token

expiresAt.description: Epoch millis when the current access token expires; 0 when the provider reports no expiry

obtained.description: Epoch millis when the user approved
